notes.title: Patch #9 - Minor Update
notes.notes:
This patch brings a few small fixes:

Increased all in-game text size in menus and HUD for better readability

Corrected a few typos across the game

Fixed a bug where control remapping didn't reset properly

Updated Unity libraries to keep the game current

As always, thanks to anyone and all who've played 🙌🏻

notes.title: Game Engine Update
notes.notes: The game engine has been updated to Unity 6, improving performance and stability, and preparing the game for future patches and additions.

notes.title: Patch #8 - NinjaThea 2 Announcement!
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the following issues:


 General fix for Steam overlay activation properly pausing the game. Activating the Steam overlay would in some cases not pause the game for up to 2 seconds. This is no longer an issue.

Astro Impact:

 Occasional crashes late in the game (wave 8 and onwards) due to improper handling of particle effects, causing memory overload. Particle effects are now properly handled—so you can keep blasting asteroids without interruptions!

Brick Smash:

 The ball getting stuck bouncing between the edges of the screen or paddle for too long. Instead of waiting for 6 hits to change the angle ("unstuck" the ball), the ball will now adjust after just 3 edge/paddle hits—making the gameplay faster. You can still use the boost function at any time to get "unstuck," but if you don't want to, it happens faster now.


What's Next? NinjaThea 2 is Coming!

Get ready for NinjaThea 2, a classic 2D platformer where you help Thea, a small yet fearless ninja girl, reclaim her stolen diamonds and fruits! The critters are back for revenge, and only Thea can stop them.

Try out the demo and whishlist it:

notes.title: Patch #7 - Leaderboard bugfix
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a bug where usernames longer than 20 characters would cause the leaderboard text to break, disrupting the display.

Sorry for the inconvenience! 🙌🏻

notes.title: Patch #6 - Minor bugfixes
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the following issues:

Astro Impact:

 RNG bug causing asteroids to occasionally spawn in a set pattern, which also affected supply satellite spawning.

Alien Assault:

 Highscore save bug that would some times overwrite an existing highscore with a lower score. This issue did not affect the global leaderboard, only the local save file.

I hope these small fixes improve gameplay.

notes.title: Patch #5 - Alien Assault Respawn Bugfix
notes.notes:
This patch fixes a respawn bug in Alien Assault where players could, under certain circumstances, respawn during the Game Over screen.

Additionally, it includes a few minor UI tweaks.

notes.title: Patch #4 - Achievement adjustment
notes.notes:
This patch adjusts the requirements for a few achievements to make them less of a chore. Hopefully, more players can now unlock these without getting too bored.

Astro Impact:

 Red Rampage, Blue Breakthrough and Green Gain: Now you only need to reach wave 4 with each, down from 5.

Brick Smash:

 Night Sky Knight: Requirement changed to reach level 6, previously 8.

notes.title: Patch #3 - Preparing for Alien Assault
notes.notes:
The third game in the series, Alien Assault, is in its last phase of development with an expected release date of March 3, 2024.

A demo of the current state can be seen here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DzkXNs8T3FI

Besides testing, work still remains on:

 Powerups and achievements
 Enemy wave progression and difficulty


Updates included in this patch are:

 Manage UI animation using 3rd party library (DOTween) instead of Unity's built in animator
 Updated main menu game descriptions and images
 New ball animations in Brick Smash
 Fixed an issue with faulty random asteroid spawns in Astro Impact.

notes.notes:
Contains the following updates:


 New options: resolution settings and master audio adjustment.

notes.title: Development News - Autumn Update
notes.notes:
After a long summer and early autumn of regular work, I'm finally back and working on the next game in the collection: Alien Assault. The following is finished using placeholder graphics (and no music/sfx yet):

 Core gameplay mechanics (movement, shooting, death/respawn, enemies/waves ++)
 Input remapping
 Steam Leaderboard

Next on the agenda is gameplay loop (bosses, transitions, achievements), graphics (pixel art/animations), and music/sfx.

In addition, more options are added to the settings:

 Resolution
 Graphics quality
 Master volume

Also working on new Steam store and Steam client graphical assets. All coming soon!

Check out this short video for a demo of it all: [previewyoutube=MoRaPvXL1fw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Development news - Summer update
notes.notes:
Development is going ahead well and the new power ups for Astro Impact and Brick Smash are being tested. These will release by end of July 2023.

Development on Alien Assault (remake inspired by Space Invaders) is started with basic menu navigation and core gameplay mechanics. Expected release Q1 2024.

Astro Impact
Two new power ups are being tested:

Infinite boost (temporary)
Grants the player infinite boost for a limited time. 30 seconds as of writing this, actual duration pending further testing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43880786/255833b15910300a63c5fdb027809b5b1a7a3de5.gif

Increased speed
A one time only power up, permanently increasing player movement by one point. As of writing this, will only spawn from wave 3 onwards. Actual spawn time pending further testing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43880786/bf99f8dfedee123db53a40a5390be41072b881b4.gif

Additional weapon power ups such as homing missiles are also in the works, but not ready to test yet.

Brick Smash
One new power up is being tested:

Invincibility (temporary)
Grants the player (ball) invincibility for a limited time. 30 seconds as of writing this, actual duration pending further testing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43880786/99651ecdcdc6c9d101332d377490173c243fb232.gif

When invincible, the player ball regardless of which color originally, will change to pulsating black:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43880786/3f7003e7df8f775aa48d5af21cf0311dee689edd.gif

Alien Assault
Started work on the following:

 Basic menu navigation, including HUD and pause menu
 Core gameplay (enemy waves, cannon movement etc) - with placeholder art
 Input controls and remapping

Have a great summer 🌞

notes.title: Final touches before release!
notes.notes:
The release build is ready and the final changes from the playtest feedback are implemented, including:


 Astro Impact (Asteroids): Enemy homing missile speed tweaked, added slight randomness to chase speed and turn speed.
 Brick Smash (Breakout): Reverse paddle "powerup" is now timed (temporary) and wears out after a certain period, reverting the controls to normal. The time it lasts increases for every level, starting at 30 sec and increasing as you progress through the levels.

In addition, the final 3 bosses of Astro Impact and 2 new types of enemy homing missiles are added; as well as the remaining achievements, bringing the total up to 18.

Unfortunately, the new items asked for during playtest are not ready to implement for release, but will be added asap after. I'm hoping to properly implement these and release them by end of August this year. The new items are:


 Astro Impact (Asteroids):
  
     Weapon upgrade – Homing missiles
     Speed upgrade (permanent) – Increases movement speed of the ship
     Infinite boost (temporary) – Use your boost as much as you want (lasts for 30 sec)
   Brick Smash (Breakout):
  
     Invincibility (temporary) – Ball cannot be destroyed, regardless of what it touches
     Infinite power shot (temporary) – Use your power shot as much as you want (lasts for 15 sec)
  
 Finally, basic input handling and menu setup for the next title, Space Invaders, is implemented. That game will be released (for free) Q1 2024.

Have a look at some of the features here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MvMQ4HkjYoM

notes.title: Ready for release June 7th 08:00 PDT (17:00 CET)
notes.notes:
Once again, massive thanks to everyone who took the time to play the game during the playtest and give feedback.

All the issues reported are fixed and verified (see comments here).

In addition, two new unique bosses will be added to Astro Impact (Asteroids):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43880786/703757d0c5750d26d5d1a7837e596911d79dc0c2.gif

And a total of 18 achievements will be added, 9 each for each game.

The game will launch for sale on June 7th @08:00 PDT (17:00 CET) for 2.99USD.

Additional powerups are also being assessed, but will not be implemented or added to the game until after release. The powerups being tested are:

 Astro Impact (Asteroids): Increased speed, reduced boost power consumption, homing missiles
 Brick Smash (Breakout): Invincibility (short time), increased platform speed, reduced platform speed (negative powerup)

Work on the next title in the collection, Alien Assault (Space invaders), has started and it will be added to the game Q1 2024.
